questions.why: 「warn+목적어+not to-v」로 to부정사 앞에 not을 두어 부정한다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The portrait appears ____ by a student, not by the master himself.
questions.why: 그림은 그려진 대상이고 그린 시점이 appears보다 앞서므로 완료 수동 to have been painted를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? It was reckless ____ the driver to ignore the red light.
questions.why: reckless는 사람의 성품을 평가하는 형용사이므로 「of+목적격」을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? It took nearly two hours ____ the workers to clear the fallen tree.
questions.why: 「It takes+시간+for+목적격+to-v」 구문으로, 의미상의 주어는 for로 나타낸다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? This report is far too technical ____ a beginner to understand without help.
questions.why: 「too+형용사+for+목적격+to-v」 구문이므로 의미상의 주어는 for로 나타낸다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The novelist is said ____ four languages fluently when she was a child.
questions.why: 어린 시절은 is said보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사 to have spoken을 쓴다. 언어를 말하는 주체이므로 수동형은 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? She is very proud ____ the national scholarship last spring.
questions.why: last spring은 is proud보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사 to have won을 쓴다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은? It is generous (A)[for / of] her to share her lecture notes, and it is helpful (B)[for / of] us to have them before the exam.
questions.why: (A) generous는 성품 형용사이므로 of, (B) helpful은 성품 형용사가 아니므로 for를 쓴다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은? He seems (A)[to be / to have been] calm now, but he is said (B)[to be / to have been] furious when he first heard the news.
choices: to have been - to have been
questions.why: (A)는 now이므로 본동사와 같은 때인 단순부정사, (B)는 처음 소식을 들었던 과거이므로 완료부정사를 쓴다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은? The town is believed (A)[to found / to have been founded] in the 12th century, and it appears (B)[to have kept / to have been kept] its old stone walls ever since.
choices: to found - to have been kept
to have been founded - to have kept
to have been founded - to have been kept
to have been founded - to keep
questions.why: (A) 마을은 세워진 대상이고 12세기는 앞선 때이므로 완료 수동, (B) 마을이 성벽을 간직해 온 것이므로 능동인 to have kept를 쓴다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은? Visitors are asked (A)[not to touch / to not touch] the paintings, and it is reasonable (B)[for / of] the museum to require that.
questions.why: (A) to부정사의 부정은 not을 to 앞에 두고, (B) reasonable은 성품 형용사가 아니므로 for를 쓴다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은? It took an hour (A)[for / of] the technician to fix the printer, and it was thoughtful (B)[for / of] him to explain the cause of the problem.
questions.why: (A)는 「It takes+시간+for+목적격」 구문이고, (B) thoughtful은 성품 형용사이므로 of를 쓴다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은? The file appears (A)[to be lost / to have been lost] during the move last month, so the staff were told (B)[not to delete / to not delete] any backups.
choices: to be lost - not to delete
to be lost - to not delete
to have been lost - not to delete
to have been lost - to not delete
to have lost - not to delete
questions.why: (A) last month는 appears보다 앞선 때이고 파일은 분실된 대상이므로 완료 수동, (B) to부정사의 부정은 not을 to 앞에 둔다.

questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은? It is difficult (A)[for / of] students to concentrate late at night, so it was wise (B)[for / of] the school to move the class, which seems (C)[to be / to have been] effective since last March.
questions.why: (A) difficult는 for, (B) wise는 성품 형용사여서 of, (C) since last March는 앞선 때부터 이어지므로 완료부정사를 쓴다.

questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은? The climber is said (A)[to reach / to have reached] the summit in 1953, and he was careful (B)[not to leave / to not leave] any trash behind, which was considerate (C)[for / of] him.
choices: to reach - not to leave - of
to have reached - not to leave - of
to have reached - to not leave - of
to have reached - not to leave - for
to reach - to not leave - for
questions.why: (A) 1953년은 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사, (B) 부정은 not+to-v, (C) considerate는 성품 형용사이므로 of를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법에 맞는 문장은?
choices: It is kind for the manager to approve our request.
It was clever for him to record the lecture.
It is essential of us to arrive on time.
It was cruel of them to abandon the puppy.
It is convenient of me to work from home.
questions.why: cruel은 성품 형용사이므로 of them이 맞다. kind, clever도 of를 써야 하고, essential과 convenient는 for를 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
choices: He is said to have studied art in Paris.
She seems to have forgotten my name.
The envelope appears to have been opened.
They seem to have arrived while we were out.
He seems to be very tired last night.
questions.why: last night은 seems보다 앞선 때이므로 to be가 아니라 to have been으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: I decided to not attend the ceremony.
She warned me to not go near the cliff.
He was careful not to wake the baby.
They promised to never be late again.
We asked him don't smoke inside.
questions.why: to부정사의 부정은 not[never]을 to 바로 앞에 두므로 not to wake가 옳다. 나머지는 부정어의 위치나 형태가 틀렸다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: It was thoughtful of her to send flowers.
It is difficult for me to say no to friends.
It was wise of you to leave the party early.
It is natural of parents to worry about their children.
It was brave of the boy to speak up in class.
questions.why: natural은 사람의 성품이 아니라 일의 성질을 나타내므로 of가 아니라 for parents로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 다섯 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: He appears to have been a talented pianist in his youth.
It was generous for the sponsor to double the donation.
I reminded her to not forget her passport.
It is impossible of anyone to please everyone.
The bridge seems to have destroyed in the flood.
questions.why: in his youth는 appears보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사가 맞다. ②는 of, ③은 not to forget, ④는 for, ⑤는 to have been destroyed로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 것은?
choices: It took thirty minutes for us to set up the tent.
The lake is said to have frozen completely last January.
It was foolish of me to ignore the warning sign.
The children were told not to feed the animals.
It is necessary of every driver to carry a license.
questions.why: necessary는 성품 형용사가 아니므로 of가 아니라 for every driver로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 어색하지 않은 것은?
choices: It is typical of him to arrive ten minutes late.
It was necessary of her to explain the rule twice.
It seems to be raining heavily last night.
He promised to not complain about the food again.
It is easy of children to pick up new songs.
questions.why: 「typical of+목적격」은 사람의 성향을 평가하는 표현으로 옳다. ②④⑤는 for나 not to의 위치가, ③은 완료부정사가 필요하다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법에 맞지 않는 문장은?
choices: The tower is believed to have stood here for five hundred years.
She seems not to have noticed the change in the schedule.
It was considerate of you to call ahead.
We were advised not to travel alone after dark.
The novel is said to be written in 1885.
questions.why: 1885년은 is said보다 앞선 때이고 소설은 쓰인 대상이므로 to have been written으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? It was very ①<u>kind</u> ②<u>for</u> you ③<u>to lend</u> me your car when mine ④<u>broke</u> down last ⑤<u>Friday</u>.
questions.why: kind는 사람의 성품을 나타내는 형용사이므로 의미상의 주어를 of you로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? The ancient coins ①<u>found</u> in the field ②<u>are believed</u> ③<u>to be buried</u> ④<u>by</u> a merchant who ⑤<u>fled</u> the city.
questions.why: 동전이 묻힌 것은 are believed보다 앞선 일이므로 완료 수동인 to have been buried로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? My coach ①<u>advised</u> me ②<u>to not skip</u> breakfast ③<u>before</u> an important match, ④<u>which</u> ⑤<u>turned out</u> to be good advice.
questions.why: to부정사의 부정은 not을 to 앞에 두어야 하므로 not to skip으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? It ①<u>took</u> almost a year ②<u>for</u> the team ③<u>to complete</u> the project, and it was ④<u>generous</u> ⑤<u>for the company</u> to reward them.
questions.why: generous는 사람의 성품을 나타내는 형용사이므로 의미상의 주어를 of the company로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? She ①<u>seems</u> ②<u>to have been</u> a professional dancer ③<u>in her twenties</u>, ④<u>judging</u> from the way she ⑤<u>move</u> on stage.
questions.why: 관계절의 주어 she에 맞게 moves로 써야 한다. ②는 seems보다 앞선 때를 나타내는 완료부정사로 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? It was ①<u>very</u> nice ②<u>of</u> ③<u>they</u> ④<u>to invite</u> us ⑤<u>to</u> their wedding.
questions.why: to부정사의 의미상의 주어는 목적격으로 써야 하므로 they가 아니라 them으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? (1) It was foolish ____ him to quit his job so suddenly. (2) The ancient bowl seems to have been made ____ clay.
questions.why: (1)은 성품 형용사 foolish의 의미상의 주어를 나타내는 of, (2)는 재료를 나타내는 be made of의 of이다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? (1) It is necessary ____ us to book the tickets early. (2) We waited ____ more than an hour in the rain.
questions.why: (1)은 의미상의 주어를 나타내는 for, (2)는 기간을 나타내는 for이다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? (1) It was polite ____ the students to greet the guests first. (2) Most ____ the seats had already been taken.
questions.why: (1)은 성품 형용사 polite의 의미상의 주어 of, (2)는 「most of+명사」의 of이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? A: Why does Tom look so upset? B: He seems ____ his wallet on the bus this morning.
questions.why: 지갑을 잃어버린 것은 seems보다 앞선 일이므로 완료부정사 to have lost를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? A: Did you thank Ms. Park? B: Of course. It was so kind ____ her to write me a recommendation letter.
questions.why: kind는 사람의 성품을 나타내는 형용사이므로 의미상의 주어를 「of+목적격」으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? A: Is Jane still in the library? B: No. She seems ____ home already.
questions.why: already는 이미 집에 간 앞선 때를 나타내므로 완료부정사 to have gone을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그는 그 회의에 참석했던 것 같다.
choices: He seems to attend the meeting.
He seems to have attended the meeting.
He seems to be attended the meeting.
He seemed to attend the meeting.
questions.why: 참석한 것이 seems보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사 to have attended를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 네가 그렇게 말한 것은 무례했다.
choices: It was rude for you to say so.
It was rude of you to say so.
It was rude of your saying so.
It was rude for your to say so.
It was rude to you to say so.
questions.why: rude는 사람의 성품을 나타내는 형용사이므로 의미상의 주어를 「of+목적격」으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 나는 그녀에게 그 상자를 열지 말라고 부탁했다.
choices: I asked her to not open the box.
I asked her not open the box.
I asked her not to open the box.
I asked her don't open the box.
I asked her to open not the box.
questions.why: 「ask+목적어+not to-v」로 to부정사 앞에 not을 두어 부정한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? It seems that the singer has recovered from her injury.
choices: The singer seems to recover from her injury.
The singer seems to have recovered from her injury.
The singer seemed to recover from her injury.
The singer seems to be recovered from her injury.
The singer seems recovering from her injury.
questions.why: 종속절이 현재완료로 본동사 seems보다 앞선 때를 나타내므로 완료부정사 to have recovered를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? It seemed that he had missed the last train.
choices: He seemed to miss the last train.
He seemed to be missing the last train.
He seemed to have missed the last train.
He seems to have missed the last train.
He seemed to have been missed the last train.
questions.why: that절이 과거완료로 본동사 seemed보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사 to have missed를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? It is believed that the tomb was robbed centuries ago.
choices: The tomb is believed to rob centuries ago.
The tomb is believed to be robbed centuries ago.
The tomb is believed to have robbed centuries ago.
The tomb is believed to have been robbed centuries ago.
The tomb believes to have been robbed centuries ago.
questions.why: 도굴된 시점이 is believed보다 앞서고 무덤은 도굴된 대상이므로 완료 수동인 to have been robbed를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (세 단어) The temple is believed to (destroy) by a great earthquake in 1755.
questions.why: 1755년은 is believed보다 앞선 때이고 절은 파괴된 대상이므로 완료 수동 have been destroyed로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (두 단어) He seems to (study) in Germany in his twenties.
questions.why: in his twenties는 seems보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사 have studied로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (두 단어) The thief appears to (enter) through the kitchen window last night.
questions.why: last night은 appears보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사 have entered로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (세 단어) Judging from the handwriting, the note seems to (write) in a great hurry.
questions.why: 메모는 쓰인 대상이고 쓴 시점이 seems보다 앞서므로 완료 수동 have been written으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (두 단어) I am glad to be here today, but I am sorry to (miss) your speech yesterday.
questions.why: yesterday는 am sorry보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사 have missed로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. It was very generous <u>for</u> the donor to fund the whole project.
questions.why: generous는 사람의 성품을 나타내는 형용사이므로 의미상의 주어를 「of+목적격」으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. It is not easy <u>of</u> a beginner to read this scientific article.
questions.why: easy는 성품 형용사가 아니므로 의미상의 주어를 「for+목적격」으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 두 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. The manager advised us <u>to not</u> reply to that email.
questions.why: to부정사의 부정은 not을 to 바로 앞에 두어 not to로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 네 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. The victim is thought <u>to attack</u> from behind in the parking lot.
questions.why: 공격당한 것은 is thought보다 앞선 일이고 피해자는 공격받은 대상이므로 완료 수동 to have been attacked로 고친다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 세 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. The castle appears <u>to be</u> abandoned two centuries ago.
questions.why: two centuries ago는 appears보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사 to have been으로 고친다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 It seems that ~ 으로 시작하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (that절의 동사는 과거시제로) The children seem to have broken the window.
questions.answer: It seems that the children broke the window.
alt: It seems that the children broke the window
questions.why: 완료부정사는 본동사 seem보다 앞선 때를 나타내므로 that절의 동사를 과거시제 broke로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 seem을 이용해 같은 뜻으로 바꿔 쓰시오. It seems that the writer was influenced by Korean folk tales.
questions.answer: The writer seems to have been influenced by Korean folk tales.

questions.why: that절의 시제가 본동사보다 앞서므로 완료부정사를 쓰고, 영향을 받은 대상이므로 수동형 to have been influenced로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은? ㄱ. It was inconsiderate of the guests to leave without saying goodbye. ㄴ. It is vital of every member to attend the general meeting. ㄷ. The document appears to have been altered after it was signed.

questions.stem: 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은? ㄱ. She is believed to have been working on the novel for a decade before it appeared. ㄴ. He seems to not have understood the instructions. ㄷ. It was rash of him to invest all his savings in one stock.
questions.why: ㄴ은 부정어 not을 to 앞에 두어 not to have understood로 써야 한다. ㄱ은 완료 진행부정사, ㄷ은 성품 형용사 rash 뒤의 of로 옳다.

questions.stem: 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은? ㄱ. It took the committee three months for reaching a final decision. ㄴ. The fossils are thought to date back to the Jurassic period. ㄷ. We advised the tourists never to leave their bags unattended.
questions.why: ㄱ은 「It takes+목적어+시간+to-v」 구문이므로 for reaching이 아니라 to reach로 써야 한다. ㄴ은 현재도 유효한 사실이므로 단순부정사, ㄷ은 never를 to 앞에 둔 형태로 옳다.

questions.stem: 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은? ㄱ. It is careless for you to have left the stove on all night. ㄴ. The scientist claims to have discovered a new species last summer. ㄷ. The bridge is said to be built in the 1930s.
questions.why: ㄱ의 careless는 성품 형용사이므로 of you로, ㄷ은 1930년대라는 앞선 때이므로 to have been built로 고쳐야 한다. ㄴ은 last summer가 claims보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사가 옳다.

questions.stem: 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은? ㄱ. He appears not to have been informed of the schedule change. ㄴ. It was generous of the company to match every employee's donation. ㄷ. It is difficult of us to imagine life without electricity.
questions.why: ㄷ의 difficult는 성품 형용사가 아니므로 for us로 고쳐야 한다. ㄱ은 not이 to 앞에 온 완료 수동부정사, ㄴ은 성품 형용사 뒤의 of로 옳다.

questions.stem: 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은? ㄱ. She pretended not to have noticed the error in the sales report. ㄴ. It seemed that he has already left the office when we arrived. ㄷ. It was wise of them to postpone the trip until the storm passed.
questions.why: ㄴ은 주절이 과거(seemed)이고 그보다 앞선 일이므로 had already left로 써야 한다. ㄱ은 not+완료부정사, ㄷ은 성품 형용사 wise 뒤의 of로 옳다.

questions.stem: 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은? ㄱ. The novel is believed to have influenced generations of later writers. ㄴ. It is essential for the data to be verified before publication. ㄷ. The witness seems to have been lying about the time of the call.
questions.why: ㄱ은 완료부정사, ㄴ은 essential 뒤의 의미상 주어 for와 수동 부정사, ㄷ은 완료 진행부정사로 모두 옳다.

questions.stem: 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은? ㄱ. It was foolish for the hikers to ignore the weather warning. ㄴ. The letter appears to have been written by someone in a great hurry. ㄷ. He promised never to reveal the source of the story.
questions.why: ㄱ의 foolish는 성품 형용사이므로 of the hikers로 고쳐야 한다. ㄴ은 완료 수동부정사, ㄷ은 never를 to 앞에 둔 부정으로 옳다.

questions.stem: 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은? ㄱ. It is not unusual for beginners to feel anxious before their first presentation. ㄴ. The manager is reported to have resigned last Friday. ㄷ. She seems to be ill since the beginning of last month.
questions.why: ㄷ은 since로 이어지는 앞선 때이므로 to have been ill로 써야 한다. ㄱ은 unusual 뒤의 for, ㄴ은 last Friday라는 앞선 때의 완료부정사로 옳다.

questions.stem: 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은? ㄱ. It would be rude of us not to reply to their invitation. ㄴ. The captain ordered the crew not to abandon the ship. ㄷ. It was necessary of the pilot to make an emergency landing.
questions.why: ㄷ의 necessary는 성품 형용사가 아니므로 for the pilot으로 고쳐야 한다. ㄱ은 「of+목적격」과 not to-v, ㄴ은 「order+목적어+not to-v」로 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? The diary, ①<u>which</u> was discovered in an attic, ②<u>is believed</u> ③<u>to be kept</u> by a soldier during the war, and historians ④<u>consider</u> it invaluable ⑤<u>evidence</u>.
questions.why: 일기를 간직한 것은 is believed보다 앞선 전쟁 중의 일이고 일기는 간직된 대상이므로 to have been kept로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? It was ①<u>considerate</u> ②<u>of</u> the organizers ③<u>to provide</u> shuttle buses, ④<u>which</u> made it easy ⑤<u>of visitors</u> to reach the venue.
questions.why: easy는 성품 형용사가 아니므로 의미상의 주어를 for visitors로 써야 한다. ②의 of는 성품 형용사 considerate 뒤이므로 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? The researchers ①<u>warned</u> the participants ②<u>to not disclose</u> the results, ③<u>fearing</u> that early publicity ④<u>would distort</u> the findings ⑤<u>they</u> had gathered.
questions.why: to부정사의 부정은 not을 to 앞에 두어야 하므로 not to disclose로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? The company ①<u>appears</u> ②<u>to have overstated</u> its profits last year, and its auditors are said ③<u>to be</u> aware of the problem ④<u>at that time</u>, ⑤<u>which</u> shocked investors.
questions.why: at that time은 are said보다 앞선 때를 가리키므로 to have been aware로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? Although it ①<u>seemed</u> ②<u>impossible for</u> a single volunteer ③<u>to translate</u> the entire manual, she ④<u>managed</u> ⑤<u>finishing</u> it in a week.
questions.why: manage는 to부정사를 목적어로 취하므로 managed to finish로 써야 한다. ②는 impossible 뒤의 의미상 주어 for로 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? The ruins ①<u>are thought</u> ②<u>to have been abandoned</u> ③<u>long before</u> the Romans arrived, but no one knows why the inhabitants chose ④<u>to</u> ⑤<u>not return</u>.
questions.why: to부정사의 부정은 not을 to 앞에 두어 not to return으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? It is ①<u>natural of</u> young children ②<u>to imitate</u> the adults ③<u>around</u> them, so parents ④<u>are advised</u> ⑤<u>not to lose</u> their temper in front of them.

questions.why: 필사본은 필사된 대상이므로 완료 수동인 to have been copied로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? It ①<u>took</u> the rescue team ②<u>almost</u> six hours ③<u>for</u> reach the stranded climbers, who ④<u>had been warned</u> ⑤<u>not to set</u> out in such weather.
questions.why: 「It takes+목적어+시간+to-v」 구문이므로 for가 아니라 to reach로 써야 한다.

questions.why: terrifying은 사람의 성품을 나타내는 형용사가 아니므로 의미상의 주어를 for them으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? The senator ①<u>denies</u> ②<u>to have accepted</u> any gifts, though several witnesses ③<u>claim</u> ④<u>to have seen</u> him ⑤<u>at</u> the fundraising dinner.

questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은? It is (A)[typical of / typical for] her to volunteer first, and it was (B)[generous of / generous for] her to give up her weekend, though it was hard (C)[of / for] the rest of us to keep up.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? (a) It was polite of the students to stand up when the guest entered. (b) The tomb is said to have been sealed for two thousand years. (c) It is necessary for applicants to bring two photographs. (d) He decided never to speak of the incident again. (e) The email seems to have been sent by mistake.
questions.why: 다섯 문장 모두 옳다. (a)는 성품 형용사 뒤의 of, (c)는 necessary 뒤의 for, (b)와 (e)는 완료 수동부정사, (d)는 never to-v이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? (a) It was rude for him to leave in the middle of the speech. (b) The painter is believed to paint the mural in 1520. (c) It is impossible of a beginner to master this skill in a month. (d) We were asked to not use flash photography. (e) The manager appears to have known about the defect for months.
questions.why: (e)만 옳다. (a)는 of him, (b)는 to have painted, (c)는 for a beginner, (d)는 not to use로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? (a) It took us three weeks to repair the roof. (b) It was generous of the neighbors to lend us their tools. (c) The ship is thought to have sunk during a storm. (d) It is careless for the clerk to enter the wrong figures. (e) She promised to not disclose the details.
questions.why: (a), (b), (c)가 옳다. (d)는 성품 형용사 careless 뒤이므로 of the clerk, (e)는 not to disclose로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 정확한 문장은?
choices: The treaty is believed to sign in 1648.
It was inconsiderate for the driver to block the exit.
She admitted to have taken the documents.
The letters seem to have been destroyed long ago.
We were told to not discuss the case publicly.
questions.why: long ago는 seem보다 앞선 때이고 편지는 없어진 대상이므로 완료 수동부정사가 옳다. ①은 to have been signed, ②는 of the driver, ③은 admitted having taken, ⑤는 not to discuss로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: It is unusual for a first novel to sell so well.
The town appears to have changed little since the 1970s.
It was clever of the engineer to reuse the old parts.
The victim is thought to have been robbed near the station.
It was rude for the guest to comment on the host's meal.
questions.why: rude는 사람의 성품을 나타내는 형용사이므로 of the guest로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳게 쓰인 것은?
choices: It is important of us to keep every promise.
The manuscript seems to have wrote in haste.
He was fortunate not to have been injured in the crash.
It took two days for finish the repairs.
They urged the residents to not leave their homes.
questions.why: 부정어 not이 완료 수동부정사 앞에 온 형태로 옳다. ①은 for us, ②는 to have been written, ④는 to finish, ⑤는 not to leave로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 다섯 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: It would be foolish of me to refuse their help.
The satellite is reported to have burned up on reentry.
It seems to be impossible for anyone to solve the puzzle.
The suspect denies to have been at the scene.
She was careful not to reveal her true feelings.
questions.why: deny는 to부정사를 목적어로 취할 수 없으므로 denies having been으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 적절한 것은?
choices: It was necessary of him to apologize in public.
The theory is now believed to have been mistaken.
We asked the children to not run around the pool.
It is generous for the school to waive the fee.
He seems to be lost his passport during the trip.
questions.why: 과거의 이론이 잘못이었다는 앞선 때를 나타내므로 완료부정사가 옳다. ①은 for him, ③은 not to run, ④는 of the school, ⑤는 to have lost로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 잘못 쓰인 것은?
choices: The islanders are said to have used these tools for centuries.
It was thoughtless of her to forget his birthday.
It is common for scientists to disagree about the same data.
The bridge appears to have been damaged by the flood.
The teacher told us to not to be late for rehearsals.
questions.why: to부정사의 부정은 not을 to 앞에 한 번만 두므로 not to be late로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? It seems that the tribe had lived on the island for centuries before Europeans arrived. = The tribe seems ____ on the island for centuries before Europeans arrived.
questions.why: that절이 과거완료로 본동사 seems보다 앞선 때를 나타내므로 완료부정사 to have lived를 쓴다. live는 자동사이므로 수동형은 불가능하다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그 소포는 잘못된 주소로 배달되었던 것 같다.
choices: The parcel seems to deliver to the wrong address.
The parcel seems to be delivered to the wrong address.
The parcel seems to have delivered to the wrong address.
The parcel seems to have been delivered to the wrong address.
The parcel seems delivering to the wrong address.
questions.why: 소포는 배달된 대상이고 그 시점이 seems보다 앞서므로 완료 수동부정사 to have been delivered를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그런 제안을 거절하다니 그는 어리석었다.
choices: It was stupid for him to refuse such an offer.
It was stupid of him to refuse such an offer.
It was stupid of he to refuse such an offer.
It was stupid of him refusing such an offer.
It was stupid for his to refuse such an offer.
questions.why: stupid는 사람의 성품을 평가하는 형용사이므로 의미상의 주어를 「of+목적격」으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그녀는 결코 그 비밀을 누설하지 않겠다고 약속했다.
choices: She promised to never reveal the secret.
She promised never revealing the secret.
She promised never to reveal the secret.
She promised not never to reveal the secret.
She promised to reveal never the secret.
questions.why: to부정사를 부정하는 never는 to 바로 앞에 두어 never to reveal로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? It is said that the general had already surrendered when the order arrived.
choices: The general is said to surrender when the order arrived.
The general is said to be surrendered when the order arrived.
The general is said to have already surrendered when the order arrived.
The general said to have surrendered when the order arrived.
The general is saying to have surrendered when the order arrived.
questions.why: that절이 과거완료로 본동사 is said보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사 to have surrendered로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 네 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. The stone pagoda is believed <u>to build</u> during the Silla period.
questions.why: 탑이 세워진 것은 is believed보다 앞선 일이고 탑은 세워진 대상이므로 완료 수동부정사로 고친다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 세 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. The negotiator seems <u>to not have</u> read the final draft.
questions.why: 부정어 not은 to부정사 바로 앞에 두므로 not to have read가 된다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. It was ungrateful <u>for</u> the winner to ignore his teammates in the interview.
questions.why: ungrateful은 사람의 성품을 평가하는 형용사이므로 의미상의 주어를 「of+목적격」으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. It is crucial <u>of</u> the samples to be stored at a low temperature.
questions.why: crucial은 사람의 성품이 아니라 일의 중요성을 나타내므로 의미상의 주어를 「for+목적격」으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 네 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. The two landscapes appear <u>to be sold</u> at the same auction in 1902.
questions.why: 1902년은 appear보다 앞선 때이고 그림은 팔린 대상이므로 완료 수동부정사로 고친다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 세 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. The witness claims <u>to see</u> the suspect near the bank that night.
questions.why: 목격한 시점이 claims보다 앞선 that night이므로 완료부정사 to have seen으로 고친다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (세 단어) The islanders are thought to (drive) from their homeland by rising seas.
questions.why: 섬 주민들은 쫓겨난 대상이고 그 시점이 are thought보다 앞서므로 완료 수동 have been driven으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (두 단어) He is fortunate to (escape) unhurt from such a serious crash last year.
questions.why: last year는 is fortunate보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사 have escaped로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 seem을 이용해 같은 뜻의 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. It seems that the negotiations broke down long before the deadline.
questions.answer: The negotiations seem to have broken down long before the deadline.
alt: The negotiations seem to have broken down long before the deadline
questions.why: that절의 시제가 본동사 seems보다 앞서므로 완료부정사 to have broken down을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 The composer로 시작하는 수동태 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. People say that the composer wrote the symphony in a single night.
questions.answer: The composer is said to have written the symphony in a single night.
alt: The composer is said to have written the symphony in a single night
questions.why: 주절을 is said로 수동태로 바꾸고, 작곡 시점이 더 앞서므로 완료부정사 to have written을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 The vaccine으로 시작하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. It appeared that the vaccine had been tested only on animals.
questions.answer: The vaccine appeared to have been tested only on animals.
alt: The vaccine appeared to have been tested only on animals
questions.why: that절이 과거완료로 본동사 appeared보다 앞선 때이므로 완료 수동부정사를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 It seems that ~ 으로 시작하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (that절의 동사는 과거시제로) The critics seem to have underestimated her early work.
questions.answer: It seems that the critics underestimated her early work.
alt: It seems that the critics underestimated her early work
questions.why: 완료부정사는 본동사 seem보다 앞선 때를 나타내므로 that절의 동사를 과거시제로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 The artifacts로 시작하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. It is believed that the artifacts were smuggled out of the country.
questions.answer: The artifacts are believed to have been smuggled out of the country.
alt: The artifacts are believed to have been smuggled out of the country
questions.why: that절의 시제가 앞서고 유물은 밀반출된 대상이므로 완료 수동부정사 to have been smuggled를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 The manager로 시작하는 수동태 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. They believe that the manager knew about the defect.
questions.answer: The manager is believed to have known about the defect.
alt: The manager is believed to have known about the defect
questions.why: 알고 있었던 것이 believe보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사 to have known을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 말을 바르게 배열하시오. (그가 규정을 확인하지 않은 것은 부주의했다.) (of / careless / it / him / was) not to check the rules.
questions.answer: It was careless of him not to check the rules.
alt: It was careless of him not to check the rules
questions.why: careless는 성품 형용사이므로 of him을 쓰고, to부정사의 부정은 not을 to 앞에 둔다.

questions.stem: 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 말을 바르게 배열하시오. (그 회사는 세금을 축소 신고한 것으로 보도된다.) The company (have / to / is / reported / underreported) its taxes.
questions.answer: The company is reported to have underreported its taxes.
alt: The company is reported to have underreported its taxes
questions.why: 축소 신고한 시점이 is reported보다 앞서므로 완료부정사 to have underreported를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 말을 바르게 배열하시오. (우리가 그 초대를 거절하는 것은 무례할 것이다.) (be / it / rude / would / of) us to refuse the invitation.
questions.answer: It would be rude of us to refuse the invitation.
alt: It would be rude of us to refuse the invitation
questions.why: rude는 사람의 성품을 평가하는 형용사이므로 의미상의 주어를 of us로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 말을 바르게 배열하시오. (그녀는 다시는 그 실수를 저지르지 않겠다고 결심했다.) She (never / to / determined / was / make) that mistake again.
questions.answer: She was determined never to make that mistake again.
alt: She was determined never to make that mistake again
questions.why: 부정어 never는 to부정사 바로 앞에 두어 never to make로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 세 단어를 쓰시오. (그 도시는 지진으로 파괴되었다고 여겨진다.) The city is believed ____ ____ ____ destroyed by the earthquake.
questions.why: 도시가 파괴된 것은 is believed보다 앞선 일이고 파괴된 대상이므로 완료 수동부정사 to have been destroyed를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 완료부정사를 이용해 같은 뜻의 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. It seems that she was a talented violinist in her youth.
questions.answer: She seems to have been a talented violinist in her youth.
alt: She seems to have been a talented violinist in her youth
questions.why: that절의 시제(was)가 본동사(seems)보다 앞서므로 완료부정사 to have been을 쓴다.
